test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A # B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A % B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A - B means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

A @ B means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is C related to U if ‘C - O @ M # B % U’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 #
 %
 -
 @
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: C - O @ M # B % U

It means: C is the Wife of O, O is the Father of M, M is the Mother of B, B is the Brother of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f08762c20dd67cfdb461820216cc3b83bb06f8b6cd41154be1dd746119b3105.png] 

So, C is the **'Mother's mother' **of U.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
